name: Japan (1870–1999)
description: A white field with a red disc slightly offset towards the hoist, in the proportions 7:10.
history: Specification of the Hinomaru laid down by Daijō-kan Proclamation No. 57 of 27 February 1870 for merchant ships: a 7:10 flag with the sun disc three fifths of the height and its centre displaced one hundredth of the length towards the hoist. The Act on National Flag and Anthem of 13 August 1999 made the flag the legal national flag and moved the disc to the exact centre of a 2:3 field.

features.role: sun disc, offset one hundredth of the length towards the hoist
